---
title: "Tools"
---

```{=html}
<link href="../html/pages.css" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  .digitizer-shell,
  .digitizer-shell *,
  .digitizer-shell *::before,
  .digitizer-shell *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  .digitizer-shell {
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
  }

  .digitizer-hero {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 27, 41, 0.96), rgba(0, 171, 240, 0.16));
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 171, 240, 0.22);
    border-radius: 20px;
    color: #edf6ff;
    padding: 2rem;
  }

  .digitizer-hero h1 {
    color: #ffffff;
    margin: 0.25rem 0 0.65rem;
  }

  .digitizer-hero p {
    max-width: 75ch;
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }

  .digitizer-grid {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.25rem;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2.35fr) minmax(280px, 0.65fr);
    margin-top: 1.25rem;
  }

  .digitizer-card {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
    border: 1px solid rgba(8, 27, 41, 0.12);
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(8, 27, 41, 0.08);
    color: #081b29;
    padding: 1.2rem;
  }

  .digitizer-card h2,
  .digitizer-card h3 {
    margin-top: 0;
  }

  .digitizer-toolbar {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.8rem;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    margin-top: 0.9rem;
  }

  .digitizer-toolbar label,
  .digitizer-axis label {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .digitizer-toolbar input,
  .digitizer-toolbar select,
  .digitizer-axis input,
  .digitizer-axis select {
    background: #f7fbff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(8, 27, 41, 0.18);
    border-radius: 10px;
    color: #081b29;
    font: inherit;
    min-height: 2.5rem;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .digitizer-toolbar input[type="file"] {
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.45rem;
  }

  .digitizer-toolbar input[type="color"] {
    cursor: pointer;
    min-height: 2.8rem;
    padding: 0.2rem;
  }

  .digitizer-toolbar input[type="range"] {
    accent-color: #f06b18;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .digitizer-toolbar label:first-child,
  .digitizer-toolbar label:nth-child(2) {
    grid-column: span 1;
  }

  .digitizer-actions {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    margin-top: 1rem;
  }

  .digitizer-button {
    align-items: center;
    background: #00abf0;
    border: 2px solid #00abf0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    color: #081b29;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: inline-flex;
    font-weight: 700;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 2.65rem;
    padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: 0.22s ease;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .digitizer-button:hover {
    background: #081b29;
    color: #00abf0;
  }

  .digitizer-button.is-secondary {
    background: transparent;
    color: #081b29;
  }

  .digitizer-button.is-secondary:hover {
    background: #081b29;
    color: #00abf0;
  }

  .digitizer-stage {
    border-radius: 18px;
    height: 72vh;
    min-height: 520px;
    max-height: 84vh;
    overflow: auto;
    position: relative;
  }

  .digitizer-stage canvas {
    background: #081b29;
    border-radius: 18px;
    display: block;
    height: auto;
    margin: 0 auto;
    max-width: 100%;
    touch-action: none;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .digitizer-status {
    background: rgba(0, 171, 240, 0.08);
    border-left: 4px solid #00abf0;
    border-radius: 12px;
    margin-top: 0.9rem;
    padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  }

  .digitizer-status strong {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
  }

  .digitizer-pill {
    background: #00abf0;
    border-radius: 999px;
    color: #081b29;
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .digitizer-note {
    background: rgba(237, 237, 237, 0.88);
    border-left: 4px solid #00abf0;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 0.95rem 1rem;
  }

  .digitizer-note strong {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  }

  .digitizer-output-options {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.55rem 0.9rem;
    margin-top: 0.9rem;
  }

  .digitizer-output-options label {
    align-items: center;
    display: inline-flex;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .digitizer-output-options input {
    accent-color: #00abf0;
    height: 1rem;
    width: 1rem;
  }

  .digitizer-results {
    margin-top: 1rem;
    overflow: auto;
    max-height: 34rem;
  }

  .digitizer-results table {
    border-collapse: collapse;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .digitizer-results th,
  .digitizer-results td {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(8, 27, 41, 0.1);
    padding: 0.55rem 0.5rem;
    text-align: left;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .digitizer-results th {
    background: #f6fbff;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .digitizer-layout {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.9rem;
  }

  .digitizer-axis {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.8rem;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .digitizer-axis .full {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .digitizer-scale-bar {
    background: rgba(0, 171, 240, 0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 171, 240, 0.18);
    border-radius: 12px;
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    padding: 0.8rem;
  }

  .digitizer-scale-bar legend {
    float: none;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    width: auto;
  }

  .digitizer-scale-controls {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .digitizer-help {
    color: rgba(8, 27, 41, 0.74);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    margin: 0.6rem 0 0;
  }

  @media (max-width: 980px) {
    .digitizer-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .digitizer-stage {
      height: 62vh;
      min-height: 420px;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    .digitizer-toolbar,
    .digitizer-actions,
    .digitizer-axis {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .digitizer-axis .full,
    .digitizer-scale-bar {
      grid-column: auto;
    }

    .digitizer-scale-controls {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
  }
</style>

<section class="digitizer-shell">
  <div class="digitizer-hero">
    <span class="digitizer-pill">Tools</span>
    <h1>Data Digitiziar</h1>
    <p>
      A self-contained browser digitizer for plot images. Upload a figure, define the plot area,
      calibrate the axes, and extract points or color-matched curves entirely in the browser. 
    </p>
  </div>

  <div class="digitizer-grid">
    <div class="digitizer-card">
      <h2>Image workspace</h2>
      <p class="digitizer-help">
        Upload a plot image, then drag to define the plot box. Click inside the box to add manual
        points, then place one seed point on the target curve before running auto extraction.
      </p>

      <div class="digitizer-toolbar">
        <label>
          Upload image
          <input id="digitizer-file" type="file" accept="image/*">
        </label>

        <label>
          Mode
          <select id="digitizer-mode">
            <option value="manual">Manual points</option>
            <option value="auto">Auto extract by color</option>
          </select>
        </label>

        <label>
          Target color
          <input id="digitizer-color" type="color" value="#ff0000">
        </label>

        <label>
          Tolerance
          <input id="digitizer-tolerance" type="range" min="0" max="180" value="60">
        </label>

        <label>
          Sample step
          <input id="digitizer-step" type="range" min="1" max="20" value="2">
        </label>

        <label>
          Canvas zoom
          <input id="digitizer-zoom" type="range" min="50" max="250" value="100">
        </label>
      </div>

      <div class="digitizer-actions">
        <button id="digitizer-plotbox-btn" class="digitizer-button" type="button">Set plot box</button>
        <button id="digitizer-legendbox-btn" class="digitizer-button is-secondary" type="button">Set legend box</button>
        <button id="digitizer-reset-box-btn" class="digitizer-button is-secondary" type="button">Use full image</button>
        <button id="digitizer-clear-legend-btn" class="digitizer-button is-secondary" type="button">Clear legend box</button>
        <button id="digitizer-extract-btn" class="digitizer-button" type="button">Extract points</button>
        <button id="digitizer-clear-btn" class="digitizer-button is-secondary" type="button">Clear points</button>
        <button id="digitizer-undo-btn" class="digitizer-button is-secondary" type="button">Undo last point</button>
        <button id="digitizer-download-btn" class="digitizer-button is-secondary" type="button">Download CSV</button>
      </div>

      <div id="digitizer-stage" class="digitizer-stage" style="margin-top: 1rem;">
        <canvas id="digitizer-canvas" aria-label="Digitizer canvas"></canvas>
      </div>

      <div class="digitizer-status" id="digitizer-status">
        <strong>Ready</strong>
        Upload an image to begin.
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="digitizer-layout">
      <div class="digitizer-card">
        <h2>Axis calibration</h2>
        <div class="digitizer-axis">
          <fieldset class="digitizer-scale-bar">
            <legend>Axis scale</legend>
            <div class="digitizer-scale-controls">
              <label>
                X axis
                <select id="digitizer-xscale">
                  <option value="linear">Linear</option>
                  <option value="log">Log</option>
                </select>
              </label>
              <label>
                Y axis
                <select id="digitizer-yscale">
                  <option value="linear">Linear</option>
                  <option value="log">Log</option>
                </select>
              </label>
            </div>
          </fieldset>
          <label>
            X minimum
            <input id="digitizer-xmin" type="number" value="0" step="any">
          </label>
          <label>
            X maximum
            <input id="digitizer-xmax" type="number" value="1" step="any">
          </label>
          <label>
            Y minimum
            <input id="digitizer-ymin" type="number" value="0" step="any">
          </label>
          <label>
            Y maximum
            <input id="digitizer-ymax" type="number" value="1" step="any">
          </label>
          <label>
            Plot left
            <input id="digitizer-left" type="number" value="0" step="1">
          </label>
          <label>
            Plot right
            <input id="digitizer-right" type="number" value="1" step="1">
          </label>
          <label>
            Plot top
            <input id="digitizer-top" type="number" value="0" step="1">
          </label>
          <label>
            Plot bottom
            <input id="digitizer-bottom" type="number" value="1" step="1">
          </label>
        </div>
        <p class="digitizer-help">
          The plot box can be set manually on the canvas. Add an orange legend exclusion box when
          the legend overlaps the plot. Use log scale only with positive axis limits.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="digitizer-card">
        <h2>Results</h2>
        <div class="digitizer-note" id="digitizer-summary">
          No points yet. Manual clicks and auto extraction will appear here.
        </div>
        <div class="digitizer-output-options" aria-label="Optional output columns">
          <label>
            <input id="digitizer-show-source" type="checkbox">
            Source
          </label>
          <label>
            <input id="digitizer-show-pixelx" type="checkbox">
            Pixel X
          </label>
          <label>
            <input id="digitizer-show-pixely" type="checkbox">
            Pixel Y
          </label>
        </div>
        <div class="digitizer-results" id="digitizer-results"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
(function () {
  const fileInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-file');
  const modeInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-mode');
  const colorInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-color');
  const toleranceInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-tolerance');
  const stepInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-step');
  const zoomInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-zoom');
  const stage = document.getElementById('digitizer-stage');
  const canvas = document.getElementById('digitizer-canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const statusBox = document.getElementById('digitizer-status');
  const summaryBox = document.getElementById('digitizer-summary');
  const resultsBox = document.getElementById('digitizer-results');
  const plotBoxBtn = document.getElementById('digitizer-plotbox-btn');
  const legendBoxBtn = document.getElementById('digitizer-legendbox-btn');
  const resetBoxBtn = document.getElementById('digitizer-reset-box-btn');
  const clearLegendBtn = document.getElementById('digitizer-clear-legend-btn');
  const extractBtn = document.getElementById('digitizer-extract-btn');
  const clearBtn = document.getElementById('digitizer-clear-btn');
  const undoBtn = document.getElementById('digitizer-undo-btn');
  const downloadBtn = document.getElementById('digitizer-download-btn');
  const showSourceInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-show-source');
  const showPixelXInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-show-pixelx');
  const showPixelYInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-show-pixely');
  const xscaleInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-xscale');
  const yscaleInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-yscale');
  const xminInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-xmin');
  const xmaxInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-xmax');
  const yminInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-ymin');
  const ymaxInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-ymax');
  const leftInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-left');
  const rightInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-right');
  const topInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-top');
  const bottomInput = document.getElementById('digitizer-bottom');

  const state = {
    image: null,
    imageUrl: null,
    naturalWidth: 0,
    naturalHeight: 0,
    plotBox: null,
    legendBox: null,
    points: [],
    selectionMode: null,
    dragStart: null,
    dragCurrent: null,
  };

  function setStatus(title, message) {
    statusBox.innerHTML = '<strong>' + title + '</strong><span>' + message + '</span>';
  }

  function readNumber(input, fallback) {
    const value = Number(input.value);
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
  }

  function mapAxisValue(fraction, min, max, scale) {
    if (scale === 'log') {
      if (min <= 0 || max <= 0) return null;
      const logMin = Math.log10(min);
      const logMax = Math.log10(max);
      return 10 ** (logMin + fraction * (logMax - logMin));
    }

    return min + fraction * (max - min);
  }

  function formatDataValue(value, precision) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return '';
    if (value === 0) return '0';

    const absolute = Math.abs(value);
    if (absolute < 0.0001 || absolute >= 1000000) {
      return value.toExponential(precision).replace(/\.?0+e/, 'e');
    }

    return Number(value.toPrecision(precision + 2)).toString();
  }

  function activeOutputColumns() {
    const columns = [{ key: 'index', label: '#' }];

    if (showSourceInput.checked) columns.push({ key: 'source', label: 'Source' });
    if (showPixelXInput.checked) columns.push({ key: 'pixelX', label: 'Pixel X' });
    if (showPixelYInput.checked) columns.push({ key: 'pixelY', label: 'Pixel Y' });

    columns.push({ key: 'dataX', label: 'Data X' }, { key: 'dataY', label: 'Data Y' });
    return columns;
  }

  function hexToRgb(hex) {
    const clean = hex.replace('#', '');
    return [
      parseInt(clean.slice(0, 2), 16),
      parseInt(clean.slice(2, 4), 16),
      parseInt(clean.slice(4, 6), 16),
    ];
  }

  function resizeCanvasToImage() {
    if (!state.image) return;
    canvas.width = state.naturalWidth;
    canvas.height = state.naturalHeight;
    leftInput.value = 0;
    topInput.value = 0;
    rightInput.value = state.naturalWidth - 1;
    bottomInput.value = state.naturalHeight - 1;
    state.plotBox = {
      left: 0,
      top: 0,
      right: state.naturalWidth - 1,
      bottom: state.naturalHeight - 1,
    };
    state.legendBox = null;
    applyCanvasDisplayScale();
  }

  function applyCanvasDisplayScale() {
    if (!canvas.width || !stage) return;

    const fitScale = stage.clientWidth > 0 ? stage.clientWidth / canvas.width : 1;
    const zoomFactor = Math.max(50, Number(zoomInput.value) || 100) / 100;
    const displayScale = fitScale * zoomFactor;

    canvas.style.width = Math.round(canvas.width * displayScale) + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = Math.round(canvas.height * displayScale) + 'px';
  }

  function canvasPoint(event) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const scaleX = canvas.width / rect.width;
    const scaleY = canvas.height / rect.height;
    return {
      x: Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - 1, (event.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX)),
      y: Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - 1, (event.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY)),
    };
  }

  function syncInputsToPlotBox() {
    if (!state.plotBox) return;
    leftInput.value = Math.round(state.plotBox.left);
    rightInput.value = Math.round(state.plotBox.right);
    topInput.value = Math.round(state.plotBox.top);
    bottomInput.value = Math.round(state.plotBox.bottom);
  }

  function syncPlotBoxFromInputs() {
    if (!state.image) return;
    const maxX = state.naturalWidth - 1;
    const maxY = state.naturalHeight - 1;
    const left = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxX, readNumber(leftInput, 0)));
    const right = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxX, readNumber(rightInput, maxX)));
    const top = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxY, readNumber(topInput, 0)));
    const bottom = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxY, readNumber(bottomInput, maxY)));
    state.plotBox = {
      left: Math.min(left, right),
      right: Math.max(left, right),
      top: Math.min(top, bottom),
      bottom: Math.max(top, bottom),
    };
  }

  function draw() {
    if (!state.image) {
      canvas.width = 1200;
      canvas.height = 720;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#081b29';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(237, 246, 255, 0.9)';
      ctx.font = '28px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('Upload a plot image to start digitizing.', 36, 72);
      ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('Use Set plot box, then click points or extract a color-matched curve.', 36, 108);
      return;
    }

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.drawImage(state.image, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    if (state.plotBox) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8, 27, 41, 0.18)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.rect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      ctx.rect(
        state.plotBox.left,
        state.plotBox.top,
        state.plotBox.right - state.plotBox.left,
        state.plotBox.bottom - state.plotBox.top,
      );
      ctx.fill('evenodd');

      ctx.strokeStyle = '#00abf0';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.25, canvas.width / 950);
      ctx.setLineDash([10, 6]);
      ctx.strokeRect(
        state.plotBox.left,
        state.plotBox.top,
        state.plotBox.right - state.plotBox.left,
        state.plotBox.bottom - state.plotBox.top,
      );
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    if (state.legendBox) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff9f1a';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.25, canvas.width / 950);
      ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
      ctx.strokeRect(
        state.legendBox.left,
        state.legendBox.top,
        state.legendBox.right - state.legendBox.left,
        state.legendBox.bottom - state.legendBox.top,
      );
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    if (state.selectionMode && state.dragStart && state.dragCurrent) {
      const left = Math.min(state.dragStart.x, state.dragCurrent.x);
      const top = Math.min(state.dragStart.y, state.dragCurrent.y);
      const width = Math.abs(state.dragCurrent.x - state.dragStart.x);
      const height = Math.abs(state.dragCurrent.y - state.dragStart.y);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = state.selectionMode === 'legend' ? '#ffbf69' : '#7ef1ff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.setLineDash([8, 5]);
      ctx.strokeRect(left, top, width, height);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    for (const point of state.points) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.fillStyle = point.source === 'manual' ? '#ffb347' : '#29d17b';
      ctx.arc(point.pixelX, point.pixelY, Math.max(2.5, canvas.width / 550), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function pointToData(point) {
    const xmin = readNumber(xminInput, 0);
    const xmax = readNumber(xmaxInput, 1);
    const ymin = readNumber(yminInput, 0);
    const ymax = readNumber(ymaxInput, 1);
    const box = state.plotBox;

    if (!box) return null;

    const xSpan = box.right - box.left || 1;
    const ySpan = box.bottom - box.top || 1;
    const xFraction = (point.pixelX - box.left) / xSpan;
    const yFraction = (box.bottom - point.pixelY) / ySpan;
    const dataX = mapAxisValue(xFraction, xmin, xmax, xscaleInput.value);
    const dataY = mapAxisValue(yFraction, ymin, ymax, yscaleInput.value);

    if (dataX === null || dataY === null) return null;

    return { dataX, dataY };
  }

  function renderResults() {
    if (!state.points.length) {
      summaryBox.textContent = 'No points yet. Manual clicks and auto extraction will appear here.';
      resultsBox.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    const rows = state.points.map(function (point, index) {
      const mapped = pointToData(point);
      return {
        index: index + 1,
        source: point.source,
        pixelX: point.pixelX.toFixed(2),
        pixelY: point.pixelY.toFixed(2),
        dataX: mapped ? formatDataValue(mapped.dataX, 6) : '',
        dataY: mapped ? formatDataValue(mapped.dataY, 6) : '',
      };
    });

    const hasUnmappedRows = rows.some(function (row) {
      return row.dataX === '' || row.dataY === '';
    });
    const scaleNote = hasUnmappedRows ? ' Log axes require positive minimum and maximum values.' : '';
    const columns = activeOutputColumns();
    summaryBox.innerHTML = '<strong>' + rows.length + ' points captured</strong><span>Manual clicks are orange, auto extracted points are green.' + scaleNote + '</span>';
    resultsBox.innerHTML = [
      '<table>',
      '<thead><tr>' + columns.map(function (column) {
        return '<th>' + column.label + '</th>';
      }).join('') + '</tr></thead>',
      '<tbody>',
      rows.map(function (row) {
        return '<tr>' + columns.map(function (column) {
          return '<td>' + row[column.key] + '</td>';
        }).join('') + '</tr>';
      }).join(''),
      '</tbody></table>',
    ].join('');
  }

  function addPoint(point, source) {
    state.points.push({ pixelX: point.x, pixelY: point.y, source: source });
    draw();
    renderResults();
  }

  function pointInsideBox(point) {
    if (!state.plotBox) return true;
    return point.x >= state.plotBox.left && point.x <= state.plotBox.right && point.y >= state.plotBox.top && point.y <= state.plotBox.bottom;
  }

  function pointInsideLegend(point) {
    if (!state.legendBox) return false;
    return point.x >= state.legendBox.left && point.x <= state.legendBox.right && point.y >= state.legendBox.top && point.y <= state.legendBox.bottom;
  }

  function extractColorPoints() {
    if (!state.image) {
      setStatus('No image loaded', 'Upload an image before extracting points.');
      return;
    }

    syncPlotBoxFromInputs();
    const box = state.plotBox;
    if (!box || box.right <= box.left || box.bottom <= box.top) {
      setStatus('Invalid plot box', 'The plot box must have a real width and height.');
      return;
    }

    const tolerance = Number(toleranceInput.value);
    const step = Math.max(1, Number(stepInput.value));
    const [targetR, targetG, targetB] = hexToRgb(colorInput.value);

    const offscreen = document.createElement('canvas');
    offscreen.width = canvas.width;
    offscreen.height = canvas.height;
    const offCtx = offscreen.getContext('2d');
    offCtx.drawImage(state.image, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    const imageData = offCtx.getImageData(box.left, box.top, box.right - box.left + 1, box.bottom - box.top + 1).data;
    const width = box.right - box.left + 1;
    const height = box.bottom - box.top + 1;
    const extracted = [];
    const maxJump = Math.max(8, height * 0.12);
    const maxSlope = Math.max(3, height * 0.06);
    const maxGapColumns = 12;
    const xSamples = [];
    const columnRuns = [];

    function buildRuns(columnYs) {
      const runs = [];
      let start = columnYs[0];
      let end = columnYs[0];

      for (let i = 1; i < columnYs.length; i += 1) {
        if (columnYs[i] <= end + 1) {
          end = columnYs[i];
          continue;
        }

        runs.push({
          y: (start + end) / 2,
          length: end - start + 1,
        });
        start = columnYs[i];
        end = columnYs[i];
      }

      runs.push({
        y: (start + end) / 2,
        length: end - start + 1,
      });

      return runs;
    }

    function pickRun(runs, predictedY) {
      if (!runs.length) return null;

      let best = null;
      for (const run of runs) {
        const score = Math.abs(run.y - predictedY) + Math.max(0, 3 - run.length) * 2;
        if (!best || score < best.score) {
          best = { run: run, score: score };
        }
      }

      return best ? best.run : null;
    }

    for (let x = 0; x < width; x += step) {
      const matches = [];

      for (let y = 0; y < height; y += 1) {
        const absoluteX = box.left + x;
        const absoluteY = box.top + y;
        if (pointInsideLegend({ x: absoluteX, y: absoluteY })) {
          continue;
        }

        const index = (y * width + x) * 4;
        const r = imageData[index];
        const g = imageData[index + 1];
        const b = imageData[index + 2];
        const distance = Math.sqrt((r - targetR) ** 2 + (g - targetG) ** 2 + (b - targetB) ** 2);

        if (distance <= tolerance) {
          matches.push(y);
        }
      }

      xSamples.push(x);
      columnRuns.push(matches.length ? buildRuns(matches) : []);
    }

    function track(direction, seedIndex, seedY) {
      let previousY = seedY;
      let slope = 0;
      let gaps = 0;

      for (let i = seedIndex + direction; i >= 0 && i < xSamples.length; i += direction) {
        const runs = columnRuns[i];
        const predictedY = previousY + slope;

        if (!runs.length) {
          gaps += 1;
          if (gaps > maxGapColumns) {
            break;
          }
          continue;
        }

        const bestRun = pickRun(runs, predictedY);
        if (!bestRun) {
          continue;
        }

        const jump = bestRun.y - previousY;
        if (Math.abs(jump) > maxJump) {
          gaps += 1;
          if (gaps > maxGapColumns) {
            break;
          }
          continue;
        }

        gaps = 0;
        slope = Math.max(-maxSlope, Math.min(maxSlope, 0.65 * slope + 0.35 * jump));
        previousY = bestRun.y;

        extracted.push({
          x: box.left + xSamples[i],
          y: box.top + bestRun.y,
          source: 'auto',
        });
      }
    }

    const manualCandidates = state.points.filter(function (point) {
      return point.source === 'manual' &&
        point.pixelX >= box.left && point.pixelX <= box.right &&
        point.pixelY >= box.top && point.pixelY <= box.bottom;
    });

    let seedX = Math.floor(width * 0.5);
    let seedY = Math.floor(height * 0.5);

    if (manualCandidates.length) {
      const seedPoint = manualCandidates[manualCandidates.length - 1];
      seedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - 1, seedPoint.pixelX - box.left));
      seedY = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - 1, seedPoint.pixelY - box.top));
    }

    let seedIndex = 0;
    let bestSeedDist = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    for (let i = 0; i < xSamples.length; i += 1) {
      const dist = Math.abs(xSamples[i] - seedX);
      if (dist < bestSeedDist) {
        bestSeedDist = dist;
        seedIndex = i;
      }
    }

    const seedRuns = columnRuns[seedIndex] || [];
    let chosenSeedRun = pickRun(seedRuns, seedY);

    if (!chosenSeedRun) {
      let bestAutoSeed = null;
      const midX = Math.floor(xSamples.length / 2);
      const midY = height / 2;

      for (let i = 0; i < columnRuns.length; i += 1) {
        const runs = columnRuns[i];
        for (const run of runs) {
          const score =
            run.length * 5 -
            Math.abs(i - midX) * 0.3 -
            Math.abs(run.y - midY) * 0.08;

          if (!bestAutoSeed || score > bestAutoSeed.score) {
            bestAutoSeed = {
              score: score,
              index: i,
              run: run,
            };
          }
        }
      }

      if (bestAutoSeed) {
        seedIndex = bestAutoSeed.index;
        chosenSeedRun = bestAutoSeed.run;
      }
    }

    if (!chosenSeedRun) {
      setStatus('No matches', 'No matching curve pixels were found near the seed column.');
      return;
    }

    extracted.push({
      x: box.left + xSamples[seedIndex],
      y: box.top + chosenSeedRun.y,
      source: 'auto',
    });

    track(1, seedIndex, chosenSeedRun.y);
    track(-1, seedIndex, chosenSeedRun.y);

    extracted.sort(function (a, b) {
      return a.x - b.x;
    });

    if (!extracted.length) {
      setStatus('No matches', 'The chosen color did not match any pixels inside the plot box.');
      return;
    }

    state.points = state.points.filter(function (point) {
      return point.source !== 'auto';
    }).concat(extracted.map(function (point) {
      return { pixelX: point.x, pixelY: point.y, source: point.source };
    }));

    draw();
    renderResults();
    setStatus('Auto extraction complete', extracted.length + ' points were captured using the selected color.');
  }

  function downloadCsv() {
    if (!state.points.length) {
      setStatus('No data', 'Add or extract points before downloading a CSV.');
      return;
    }

    const columns = activeOutputColumns();
    const csvLabels = {
      index: 'index',
      source: 'source',
      pixelX: 'pixel_x',
      pixelY: 'pixel_y',
      dataX: 'data_x',
      dataY: 'data_y',
    };
    const lines = [columns.map(function (column) {
      return csvLabels[column.key];
    }).join(',')];

    for (const point of state.points) {
      const mapped = pointToData(point);
      const row = {
        index: String(lines.length),
        source: point.source,
        pixelX: point.pixelX.toFixed(4),
        pixelY: point.pixelY.toFixed(4),
        dataX: mapped ? formatDataValue(mapped.dataX, 10) : '',
        dataY: mapped ? formatDataValue(mapped.dataY, 10) : '',
      };

      lines.push(columns.map(function (column) {
        return row[column.key];
      }).join(','));
    }

    const blob = new Blob([lines.join('\n')], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = 'data_digitiziar_points.csv';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    setStatus('CSV downloaded', 'The digitized points have been exported.');
  }

  fileInput.addEventListener('change', function () {
    const file = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (state.imageUrl) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(state.imageUrl);
    }

    state.imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = function () {
      state.image = image;
      state.naturalWidth = image.naturalWidth;
      state.naturalHeight = image.naturalHeight;
      resizeCanvasToImage();
      state.points = [];
      draw();
      renderResults();
      setStatus('Image loaded', 'Drag on the canvas to define the plot box, then digitize points.');
    };
    image.src = state.imageUrl;
  });

  modeInput.addEventListener('change', function () {
    setStatus('Mode changed', modeInput.value === 'manual' ? 'Manual point placement is active.' : 'Auto color extraction is active.');
  });

  zoomInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
    applyCanvasDisplayScale();
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    applyCanvasDisplayScale();
  });

  plotBoxBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    state.selectionMode = state.selectionMode === 'plot' ? null : 'plot';
    state.dragStart = null;
    state.dragCurrent = null;
    plotBoxBtn.textContent = state.selectionMode === 'plot' ? 'Drawing plot box...' : 'Set plot box';
    legendBoxBtn.textContent = 'Set legend box';
    setStatus(state.selectionMode === 'plot' ? 'Plot box mode' : 'Plot box mode off', state.selectionMode === 'plot' ? 'Drag across the canvas to define the plot area.' : '');
    draw();
  });

  legendBoxBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    state.selectionMode = state.selectionMode === 'legend' ? null : 'legend';
    state.dragStart = null;
    state.dragCurrent = null;
    legendBoxBtn.textContent = state.selectionMode === 'legend' ? 'Drawing legend box...' : 'Set legend box';
    plotBoxBtn.textContent = 'Set plot box';
    setStatus(state.selectionMode === 'legend' ? 'Legend box mode' : 'Legend box mode off', state.selectionMode === 'legend' ? 'Drag across the legend area to exclude it from extraction.' : '');
    draw();
  });

  resetBoxBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!state.image) return;
    state.plotBox = {
      left: 0,
      top: 0,
      right: state.naturalWidth - 1,
      bottom: state.naturalHeight - 1,
    };
    syncInputsToPlotBox();
    draw();
    setStatus('Plot box reset', 'The full image is now the plot area.');
  });

  clearLegendBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    state.legendBox = null;
    if (state.selectionMode === 'legend') {
      state.selectionMode = null;
      legendBoxBtn.textContent = 'Set legend box';
    }
    draw();
    setStatus('Legend box cleared', 'Legend exclusion has been removed.');
  });

  extractBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    extractColorPoints();
  });

  clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    state.points = [];
    draw();
    renderResults();
    setStatus('Points cleared', 'All digitized points were removed.');
  });

  undoBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    state.points.pop();
    draw();
    renderResults();
    setStatus('Last point removed', 'The most recent point was deleted.');
  });

  downloadBtn.addEventListener('click', downloadCsv);

  for (const input of [showSourceInput, showPixelXInput, showPixelYInput]) {
    input.addEventListener('change', renderResults);
  }

  for (const input of [xscaleInput, yscaleInput, xminInput, xmaxInput, yminInput, ymaxInput, leftInput, rightInput, topInput, bottomInput]) {
    input.addEventListener('change', function () {
      if (input === leftInput || input === rightInput || input === topInput || input === bottomInput) {
        syncPlotBoxFromInputs();
      }
      draw();
      renderResults();
    });
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (event) {
    if (!state.image) return;
    const point = canvasPoint(event);

    if (state.selectionMode) {
      state.dragStart = point;
      state.dragCurrent = point;
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      draw();
      return;
    }

    if (state.selectionMode) return;
    if (modeInput.value !== 'manual') return;
    if (!pointInsideBox(point)) {
      setStatus('Outside plot box', 'Click inside the plot box to add a manual point.');
      return;
    }
    if (pointInsideLegend(point)) {
      setStatus('Inside legend box', 'That point is inside the legend exclusion box.');
      return;
    }

    addPoint(point, 'manual');
    setStatus('Point added', 'Manual point ' + state.points.length + ' captured.');
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', function (event) {
    if (!state.selectionMode || !state.dragStart) return;
    state.dragCurrent = canvasPoint(event);
    draw();
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', function (event) {
    if (!state.selectionMode || !state.dragStart) return;

    state.dragCurrent = canvasPoint(event);
    const left = Math.min(state.dragStart.x, state.dragCurrent.x);
    const right = Math.max(state.dragStart.x, state.dragCurrent.x);
    const top = Math.min(state.dragStart.y, state.dragCurrent.y);
    const bottom = Math.max(state.dragStart.y, state.dragCurrent.y);

    if (right - left < 8 || bottom - top < 8) {
      setStatus('Plot box too small', 'Drag a larger region to define the plot area.');
      state.dragStart = null;
      state.dragCurrent = null;
      draw();
      return;
    }

    if (state.selectionMode === 'legend') {
      state.legendBox = { left: left, top: top, right: right, bottom: bottom };
      state.selectionMode = null;
      legendBoxBtn.textContent = 'Set legend box';
      state.dragStart = null;
      state.dragCurrent = null;
      draw();
      setStatus('Legend box saved', 'The orange box will be excluded from auto extraction.');
      return;
    }

    state.plotBox = { left: left, top: top, right: right, bottom: bottom };
    syncInputsToPlotBox();
    state.dragStart = null;
    state.dragCurrent = null;
    state.selectionMode = null;
    plotBoxBtn.textContent = 'Set plot box';
    draw();
    setStatus('Plot box saved', 'Use the axis fields to calibrate the digitized points.');
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () {
    if (!state.selectionMode) return;
    state.dragCurrent = null;
    draw();
  });

  draw();
  renderResults();
})();
</script>
```
